newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares hit new record high, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares hit new record high, more gains seen.

text.p: Danish share prices closed slightly higher on Wednesday with the top-20 KFX index hitting a new all-time record closing high for the fourth consecutive day and dealers foreseeing gains ahead mostly for non-index paper.
"The share market is getting a good press these days. Small pension funds are investing in sideline paper, which could climb tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.31 point up at 139.03, a new record in overall bourse turnover of 1.502 billion crowns. The KFX March future rose 1.50 point to 140.25 with 50 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
East Asiatic was in focus, closing 13 crowns or 10-11 percent up at 137 on news of the divestment of most of its shipping activities to Norway.
B&O also did well, putting on eight crowns to finish at 300.
